description.value: A within-subject fMRI study examined how extended-release naltrexone treatment affects neural and behavioral responses to parametrically manipulated baby-schema infant faces in recently detoxified individuals with opioid use disorder.

spans.text: In the present study we tested the effects of XRNTX on the brain and behavioral response to baby schema in patients with opioid use disorder.

value: We hypothesized that XRNTX would modulate the mesocorticolimbic brain fMRI and behavioral effects of baby schema.
